privacy.meta_desc: Mwinda Market privacy policy — data collected, usage, your rights and contact.
privacy.intro_desc: Mwinda Market only collects data necessary for service operation and your shopping experience. We never sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.collect_orders: Order data (items, delivery address, payment method)

terms.title: Terms of Sale
terms.meta_desc: Mwinda Market terms of sale — ordering, payment, delivery and returns.
terms.intro_desc: By placing an order on Mwinda Market, you accept these general terms of sale. They apply to all transactions made on our platform.
terms.order_desc: Any order is definitively confirmed after payment validation via Mwinda Pay. A unique order reference is assigned and allows real-time tracking.
terms.payment_desc: Payment is secured via Mwinda Pay. Funds are held in escrow until delivery confirmation. In case of dispute, Mwinda Market arbitrates and refunds if necessary.
terms.delivery_desc: Delivery times vary by province and seller availability. Delivery fees are calculated at checkout based on your zone.
terms.returns_desc: You have 7 days after receipt to report a non-conforming or damaged product. In case of validated dispute, the refund is processed to your mobile money within 3 to 5 business days.
terms.seller_desc: Each seller is responsible for accurate product descriptions and meeting announced deadlines. Mwinda Market conducts regular audits and may suspend any non-compliant seller.

help.title: Help Center
help.meta_desc: Mwinda Market help and support — FAQ on orders, delivery and sellers.
help.hero_desc: Find a quick answer to your question or contact our team.
help.faq_q1: How do I place an order?
help.faq_a1: Browse our catalog, add items to your cart, select your delivery province and confirm via Mobile Money. You receive a tracking reference immediately.
help.faq_a2: Times vary by zone: 24-48h for Kinshasa and major cities, 3-7 days for accessible provinces, and 7-14 days for remote areas.
help.faq_q3: How do I track my order?
help.faq_a3: Go to the Order Tracking page and enter your reference (e.g. MW-1250). You'll see real-time status and your parcel's estimated position.
help.faq_q4: How do I become a seller?
help.faq_a4: Click 'Become a Seller', fill in the registration form with your shop details and await our team's validation (within 48h).
help.faq_q5: What if my parcel doesn't arrive?
help.faq_a5: If your parcel exceeds the announced deadline, contact us via WhatsApp or phone. Mwinda Pay funds remain locked until resolution — you are protected.
help.contact_hours: Available 7 days a week from 8am to 8pm (Kinshasa time)
